manifesto.text: Most growing teams run on spreadsheets, chat threads and one person's memory. Work slips between people, numbers don't match, and nobody can see what's stuck. We replace all of that with one system,
manifesto.accent: built around how your team really works.

services.title: Four kinds of systems.

items.title: Workflow systems
items.desc: Your process as software: steps, roles, handoffs, approvals and notifications.
items.eg: Production pipelines, approval flows, operations boards.

items.title: Dashboards & reporting
items.desc: Numbers your team can trust, reconciled with the source and refreshed automatically.
items.eg: Revenue reporting, client reports, payroll from real work data.

items.title: Integrations
items.desc: The tools you already use, connected so data moves without copy-paste.
items.eg: Meta, YouTube, Google Sheets and Drive, Slack, booking and payment systems.

items.title: AI automation
items.desc: Language models put to work on scoring, drafting, triage and planning, with a person checking what matters.
items.eg: Lead scoring, content planning, document triage.

services.also: Also: performance audits for slow or expensive apps, and websites for businesses that want to look the part.

shift.body: We map how your team really works, then build one system for it: every step, every handoff and every number in one place. Then we stay on to keep it running.

work.title: Built, shipped and in daily use.

lb.title: LB Hairdesign
lb.desc: A booking, finance and client-account platform for a premium salon. It replaced manual scheduling and cut the time spent on bookings by 70%.

tafa.title: Auto Tafa
tafa.desc: A dealership platform that turned static listings into a searchable inventory, with advanced filters, live stock and lead capture.

arsa.title: Arsa Gipser
arsa.desc: Projects, services and references for a Swiss plastering company, localized for its market.

andi.title: Andi Shkodra
andi.desc: A clear, fast campaign site for a municipal assembly candidate in Gjilan.

steps.title: Map
steps.desc: We sit with the people doing the work and map the real process. You get a written scope and a fixed plan.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: Weekly releases you can click on, not status reports. Your feedback goes straight into the next version.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: The new system runs alongside the old way until your team trusts it. Then the spreadsheets get switched off.

steps.title: Run
steps.desc: Monitoring, fixes and improvements after launch. We stay on, so the system keeps up with the business.

studio.title: Small enough to care. Engineered to last.
studio.p1: Art Halimi Studio is an independent software studio in Gelsenkirchen, Germany, working with teams in Germany, Switzerland and beyond that have outgrown spreadsheets and off-the-shelf tools.

principles.title: You talk to the people building it.
principles.desc: No account managers in between. The engineer on your project is in your calls.

principles.title: We measure before we change anything.
principles.desc: Decisions come from logs, timings and real usage, not guesses.

principles.title: We stay after launch.
principles.desc: Software that runs a business needs looking after. That's part of the job.

studio.founder: Founded by Art Halimi, full-stack engineer.
studio.languages: Projects run in English or Albanian.
